name: Cadet Certificate of Proficiency (miniature medal body)
size_basis: estimated: the body measured in the Vanguard product photograph against the suspension ribbon's width, 132 px taken as 0.6875 in (the miniature suspension ribbon, 11/16 in, CAPR 39-1 11.3 as compose.js MINI_DRAPE): body 0.776 x 0.776 in in the photograph. Height follows the body's own aspect. The width is the existing CAP asset's (0.625 in, assets/medals, kept as the brief asks; the photo measures 0.776 in). The drawing keeps the width and the box; it is built from the photograph's own measured proportions (body scale 242.6 px per in, body width 0.625 in).
ribbon_attach_note: ribbon_attach is the bail axis at the box top (the box cuts the ring away) (upright body, hang angle -0.93 deg removed); compose.js hangs it at the drape's V point

dimensions.ribbon_note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices (ribbon_ref as the previous asset)

match_note: CAP body: the existing asset id and width of assets/medals/medal-cadet-certificate-of-proficiency-miniature; ribbon_ref as that asset

ribbon_ref.note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices. ribbon_attach is the top of the suspension ring.

generator: artwork-samples/assets/medals-work/design/cop.js (parameters in inches) over lib.js, common.js, font.js, emit.js; gates: kitA.js; node makeA.js cop --write

source_product.title: civil air patrol certificate of proficiency miniature medal
source_product.note: measurement reference only: never shipped, never committed

measured.photo: certificate-of-proficiency.jpeg (Vanguard photograph, 600 x 600 px, reference only)

frame.note: body width 0.625 in (the spec width) sets the scale; every length below is inches in the medal frame (origin = disc centre, +y down, UPRIGHT: the photograph is rotated by the measured hang angle into this frame)

measured.hang_angle_note: measured from the bail axis against the disc centre in the photograph (frame.js); the drawing hangs upright (bail and disc axis vertical)
not_measurable: The photograph is only 152 px across (1 px = 0.0041 in): letter forms, feather outlines and the C O P serifs are blurred; the C, O and P are drawn as a plain open arc, an oval and the skeleton-font P, with measured position, size and weight, not their serifs.

The wings: five feather bars per wing (a leading-edge crest, four long bars, a short group of three under the hub drawn as ONE curve) are placed by measurement; the individual feather outlines (each feather is an engraved loop) and the hub dome are not resolved.

The propeller blades are faint outlines in the photograph; they are drawn as two lens outlines (top blade 0.2 in, bottom 0.17 in long) at a darker tone; their exact outline, the part hidden by the O and the hub are not measured.

The medal is photographed slightly turned: the face is offset 0.0135 in left and 0.0065 in up from the silhouette centre and the right side wall is visible; the model keeps that (face group translated, wall circle R 0.3125), the wall tone is one flat grey (the photograph shows a bright edge line and a darker groove).

The suspension: a long barrel bail (0.2 in) and a thin double-wire ring; the ring is open in the photograph and its top is hidden by the drape; the full circle (r 0.135 in, fitted to the visible lower arc) is the model.
Engraving grain, specular highlights and the green cast of the photograph are not drawn: flat tones through a ramp measured from the metal.

palette.ramp: ramp measured from the reference metal (ramp.js)

gates.silhouette_iou: >= 0.95 (shipped upright miniature vs the photograph body mask rotated into the upright frame)
gates.landmarks: every named feature centroid within 0.02 in of the reference
gates.edge_recall: lit-metal outline recall >= 0.80 within 0.012 in (0.006 in reported)
gates.ribbon_attach: top centre of the ring (bail axis at the box top where the box cuts the ring)

ribbon_attach_units.basis: bail axis at the box top (the box cuts the ring away)

fidelity.note: Redrawn as clean parametric vector (LIVE13-ART 25/26): every object (disc, rim, lettering, emblem parts, bail, ring) is modelled as what it is, from measured parameters, not traced; flat tones with a lit and a shadow edge. Replaces the traced body (LIVE13-ART 20).

fit_score.note: IoU of the shipped upright miniature against the photograph body mask rotated into the upright frame (design/kitA.js)

notes: Designed miniature medal body (LIVE13-ART 26). Measured from certificate-of-proficiency.jpeg (reference only, never shipped). Cadet Certificate of Proficiency miniature: a small silvered disc with CIVIL AIR PATROL / PROFICIENCY, the CAP winged-propeller emblem and the letters C O P; reference blurrier than the others. Hang angle -0.93 deg of the photograph removed: the body hangs upright.
